mapper.sql: select s.special_id , s.special_number , s.special_name , s.species , s.stain_type , s.indicator_id , s.status , s.trial_type , s.delivery_status , s.create_by , s.create_time , s.update_by , s.update_time , s.del_flag , u.user_name , p.indicator_name from tb_special as s left join tb_pathological_indicator as p on s.indicator_id = p.indicator_id left join tb_project as pro on pro.special_id = s.special_id left join sys_user as u on u.user_id = s.create_by left join tb_special_role_user as sru on sru.special_id = s.special_id
select special_id , special_number , special_name , species , stain_type , indicator_id , status , create_by , create_time , update_by , update_time , del_flag from tb_special
mapper.select: SELECT count(sl.slide_id) FROM tb_special AS s LEFT JOIN tb_project AS p ON s.special_id = p.special_id LEFT JOIN tb_slide AS sl ON sl.project_id = p.project_id WHERE s.special_id = #{specialId} AND p.del_flag = 0 AND sl.is_delete = 0

SELECT DISTINCT c.category_Id as category_Id FROM tb_special AS s LEFT JOIN tb_project AS p ON p.special_id = s.special_id LEFT JOIN tb_slide AS sl ON sl.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN tb_marking AS m ON m.slide_id = sl.slide_id LEFT JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS ca ON ca.indicator_id = s.indicator_id INNER JOIN tb_pathological_indicator_category AS c ON c.category_id = m.category_id
AND s.special_id = #{specialId}

SELECT s.special_id, s.special_number, s.special_name, s.`status`, u.user_id, COUNT( CASE WHEN p.del_flag = '0' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS project_total FROM tb_special s LEFT JOIN tb_special_role_user u ON u.special_id = s.special_id LEFT JOIN tb_project p ON u.special_id = p.special_id
s.del_flag = 0 AND s.STATUS <> 0 AND u.`status` = 0
AND u.user_id = #{userId}
AND s.special_number like concat('%', #{specialNumber}, '%')
AND s.special_name like concat('%', #{specialName}, '%')
GROUP BY s.special_id ORDER BY s.update_time DESC

SELECT s.special_id, s.special_number, s.special_name, s.`status`, COUNT( CASE WHEN p.del_flag = '0' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS project_total FROM tb_special s LEFT JOIN tb_project p ON p.special_id = s.special_id
s.del_flag = 0 AND s.STATUS <> 0
AND s.special_number like concat('%', #{specialNumber}, '%')
AND s.special_name like concat('%', #{specialName}, '%')
GROUP BY s.special_id ORDER BY s.update_time DESC
SELECT t.diagnosis, count( 1 ) total_count FROM tb_slide t WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} and t.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY t.diagnosis
mapper.insert: insert into tb_special ( special_number, special_name, species, stain_type , indicator_id, create_by, update_by, trial_type, create_time, update_time )values( #{specialNumber}, #{specialName}, #{species}, #{stainType}, #{indicatorId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{trialType}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
